name: La Forestiere Equatoriale SA
summary: La Forestière Equatoriale SA, through its subsidiary, Sitarail, operates a railway network that transports people and goods between Ivory Coast and Burkina Faso. It offers transport and logistics services in Africa. The company is headquartered in Abidjan, Ivory Coast. La Forestière Equatoriale SA is a subsidiary of Compagnie du Cambodge.
